cards.say: A chatbot answers. An **agent** can also act: it works toward a goal, chooses tools, checks results and repeats until it's done.

cards.q: Put the agent loop in order
steps: Look at the goal and what's known
Choose a tool and use it
Decide: done, or go around again
cards.why: Look, act, read, decide. The loop repeats until the goal is met or a person steps in.

cards.q: Match each tool to its job
pairs: Prepares a message for a person to review
cards.why: Tools give the model abilities it lacks on its own, like fresh data and exact math.

cards.q: An agent is able to issue refunds. Which design is safest?
options: Let it refund anything to keep customers happy
A person approves refunds above a set amount
cards.why: Limits and human approval for risky actions keep agents useful and safe. The costlier a mistake, the more oversight it needs.

cards.before: Rules and approvals that limit what an agent can do are called
cards.why: Guardrails define what an agent may do on its own and what needs a person.
